notes: Catalog of grant keys referenced by packages/db/data/agent_registry.json. honored_by_tools is empty when no tool in apps/web/lib/mcp-tools.ts (via apps/web/lib/tak/agent-grants.ts TOOL_TO_GRANTS) checks the grant — those are aspirational grants that do not yet authorize any platform action. The tool-grant audit's GRANT-002 surfaces them as findings; backfill PRs either implement the tool or remove the grant from the registry. Descriptions are heuristic placeholders generated from the grant key — refine by hand during reconciliation. Workroom rename (EP-WORK-CONVERGENCE / BI-0702869B): both the canonical workroom_* tool name and its legacy capsule name are honored during the alias window; the legacy entries are removed when the window closes.

grants.description: Read administrative state (DB inspections, log retrieval, file reads from the running install).
Execute administrative actions (commands, migrations, seeds, service restarts, brand-design extraction, platform updates).

Create or update backlog. Pseudo-User Contract (BI-B2F7ABF5): implies the finer build-scoped grants build_evidence and build_phase_advance so existing roles keep working when build tools are refactored to the finer grants.
Read the banking books surface: bank accounts, transactions, suggested transaction matches, bank rules, and reconciliation summaries.
Mutate the banking books surface: create bank accounts, import statements, match/unmatch transactions, and create/delete bank rules. Reconciles what happened; never moves money.

Drive an authenticated browser session through the governed browser-use substrate. Side-effecting browser actions require this grant and remain bounded by approval, target-domain, and audit policies. Honors the coworker-facing drive_browser_task orchestrator and the namespaced browse_act sidecar tool.
Open, read, screenshot, and close governed browser-use sessions without authorizing side-effecting browser actions.

Pseudo-User Contract (BI-B2F7ABF5): record evidence against a FeatureBuild — execution outcome, notes, persisted artifacts. Finer-grained successor to the build-evidence-related slice of backlog_write; lets scoped coworker tokens record build progress without authority to mutate the broader backlog. Implied by backlog_write (one-way).

Pseudo-User Contract (BI-B2F7ABF5): advance a FeatureBuild's lifecycle state — promote into Build Studio, process backlog batches into builds, and (when BI-0B3B0232 lands) reopen abandoned builds. Successor to build_promote; covers the full lifecycle surface required by the Pseudo-User Contract envelope flow. Implied by build_promote (one-way) for backwards compat.

Pseudo-User Contract (BI-B2F7ABF5): advance a FeatureBuild's phase — approve or override a decomposition, propose a downstream decomposition. Finer-grained successor to the phase-advancing slice of backlog_write; gates the Ideate→Plan handoff. Implied by backlog_write (one-way).

Legacy promote-into-Build-Studio grant. Pseudo-User Contract (BI-B2F7ABF5) refactored consumers onto the broader build_lifecycle grant; this entry remains for backwards compat and implies build_lifecycle (one-way).
Read the code-graph (build/dependency impact analysis, freshness checks).
Read consumer (customer/employee) records and roster data.
Read coworker service and offer catalog entries for governed AI workforce discovery.
Create governed coworker engagement requests against catalog offers.
Pseudo-User Contract (BI-B2F7ABF5/BI-DF6079E9): drive the screen the user is on — select entities, navigate routes, open/close panels, focus fields. Read-only for the user (the coworker drives).

Pseudo-User Contract (BI-B2F7ABF5/BI-DF6079E9): pre-fill form fields on behalf of the user. Higher tier than coworker_screen_drive — the user can still override before submit, but the coworker is setting input without explicit user keystrokes.

Pseudo-User Contract (BI-B2F7ABF5/BI-DF6079E9): read the current screen's state — selected entities, focused field, open panels, route, scroll anchor. Read-only side of the coworker view-command surface (POLA-aligned per chief-architect review of PR #1361 — screen_scroll_to is read-class).

Draft a UX critique entry into the design-critique corpus. Narrower than registry_write on purpose: a coding agent may record what it observed on a screen and nothing else in the registry. Entries are always agent-proposed and never calibration-eligible; attaching a founder/designer verdict stays a human act in the portal.
Read CRM records: customer accounts, sales-pipeline opportunities, and quotes.
Draft internal CRM records: customer accounts, opportunities, and draft quotes. Does not send quotes to customers.
Start a multi-branch peer-review deliberation (consult 2-3 specialists for a decision).
Read deliberation status and outcomes (in-progress and completed peer reviews).
Move managed documents through governed publication lifecycle states.
Read managed documents, versions, references, lifecycle history, and searchable metadata.
Create, update, and link managed documents in the governed document store.
Configure the organization's OWN outbound email (SMTP) — detect provider, save settings, send a test. Operator-gated (manage_provider_connections); DPF never relays mail on the operator's behalf.

Run software/asset enrichment on demand — resolve a product's CatalogIdentity CPE + endoflife.date support-lifecycle and flag items for re-enrichment (EP-ASSET-INTELLIGENCE). Scoped finer than registry_write so enrichment mutation is separately auditable.
Propose a containment/remediation action for a security case. Recorded for human approval; never executed directly.
Record independent archetype provisioning and completeness receipts.
Record an independent initiative architecture-review receipt.
Record an independent initiative compliance-review receipt.
Record an independent initiative data-review receipt.
Record independent design, specification, plan-review, and break-fix post-implementation review receipts.
Record an independent domain or clinical review receipt.
Record non-approval initiative classification, research, and dependency evidence.
Record an independent initiative security-review receipt.
Record an independent initiative UX-fit review receipt.
Read marketing context (SEO opportunities, archetype refinement, campaign-summary intelligence).
Author marketing artifacts (custom archetypes, campaign content).
Create or update registry artifacts (knowledge articles, entity attributions, portfolio-quality resolutions, discovery triage).
Execute code in the build sandbox: read, write, edit, run tests and commands.
Open and update security cases: timeline, evidence-based verdict, detection links. Does not execute response.
Read security telemetry: OCSF security events, detections, and security cases.
Propose detection-rule tuning or suppression for operator review. Does not change rule behavior.

Propose a published statutory figure (tax rate, wage base, threshold) as reference data, with the authority's citation. Recorded as PROPOSED for human ratification; never computes money and never files. Ratification is a human-only action and is deliberately NOT covered by this grant.
Read stocked-supply levels and derived coverage: on-hand quantity, consumption from sales, days of cover, and suggested reorder quantity.
Read guest-facing storefront activity: orders (with item-quantity rollups), reservations, and inquiries.
Read child thread status and results for specialist subtask delegation.
Spawn or cancel specialist subtask child threads, and hand off / summon a named coworker.
Run governed read-only programmatic tool-calling scripts in the sandbox (run_tool_script). Default-deny; also gated by the programmatic_tool_calling flag.
Search and fetch from the public web (search engine, page fetch, branding analysis, scout research).
Adopt external branches and worktrees into Work Capsules.
Create and update Work Capsule coordination records.
Read work engagements and their materialized recurring instances.
Advance a work engagement's status lifecycle including cancel and complete; higher-privilege than create.
Create work engagements (including recurring) and append activity-timeline entries.
Read a Work Room's message feed and coworker room engagement.
Post a message into a Work Room and invite participants.
Read user-defined Workbook / Universal Grid tables: list tables, read schema, and query rows (EP-GRID-WORKBOOKS).
Create and update rows and cells in user-defined Workbook / Universal Grid tables (EP-GRID-WORKBOOKS).
